our_interpretation: Monday means April 20, 2026; assess the announced changes through the April 22 publication date.

The $10 description identifies Copilot Pro; this is a service-policy claim rather than a claim about company revenue.
The usage-limit component concerns an announced plan, not a forecast that every restriction would subsequently be implemented.
